_documentation: Jinja (server): owner, owners, full_name, his, he, him, himself, owner_gender, deployment_nature_local (True/False). Per item optional: action_label, description, requires (array: local_only, facebook), sensitivity (mature), function (must exist on AppActions in app.js). Merge file: static/data/suggestions.override.json (gitignored).

suggestions.title: Early life overview
suggestions.description: Uses biography, email, and chat context where available.
suggestions.prompt: Summarise what the archive suggests about {{owner}}'s early life. Use biography, email, and chat context where relevant.

suggestions.title: Life timeline
suggestions.description: High-level milestones inferred from the archive.
suggestions.prompt: Outline a concise life timeline for {{owner}} based on dates and events found across email, messages, photos, and other imported material.

suggestions.title: Important people
suggestions.description: Neutral summary of relationships and social circle.
suggestions.prompt: Who appear to be the most important people in {{owner}}'s life in this archive, and in one sentence each why they matter? Ground answers in messages, email, and biography where possible.

suggestions.title: Places and chapters
suggestions.description: Links people to places or periods if the data supports it.
suggestions.prompt: Describe periods or places where {{owner}}'s social life seems especially active, and name a few recurring contacts. Stay close to evidence in the archive.

suggestions.title: Sporting life (creative)
suggestions.description: Fictionalised but grounded on archive facts.
suggestions.prompt: Write a short creative sketch (a few paragraphs) about {{owner}} and sport or fitness, grounded in what the archive actually suggests. Label clearly as imaginative where you extrapolate.

suggestions.title: Career chapter (creative)
suggestions.description: Fictionalised but grounded on archive facts.
suggestions.prompt: Write a short creative sketch (a few paragraphs) about {{owner}}'s career or work life, grounded in emails and chats. Label clearly as imaginative where you extrapolate.

suggestions.title: Biography chapter titles
suggestions.prompt: Propose ten chapter titles for a biography of {{owner}}, each with one line explaining why that chapter fits the archive.

suggestions.title: Travel-related post
suggestions.description: Picks one concrete post if data exists.
suggestions.prompt: Show details for one travel-related Facebook post by {{owner}}, with date and a short summary of why it matters in context.

suggestions.title: Theatre or events post
suggestions.description: Picks one concrete post if data exists.
suggestions.prompt: Show details for one theatre- or events-related Facebook post by {{owner}}, with date and summary.

suggestions.title: What {{owner}} posts about
suggestions.prompt: Summarise the kinds of things {{owner}} posts about on Facebook, with three specific examples drawn from the archive.

suggestions.title: Random Messenger thread
suggestions.description: Summarises one one-to-one chat at random.
suggestions.prompt: List one-to-one Facebook Messenger chats, pick one at random, and summarise the tone and topics. Quote or paraphrase one representative message.

suggestions.title: Imagined conversation
suggestions.description: Clearly fictional dialogue inspired by archive tone.
suggestions.prompt: Write a short imagined conversation between {{owner}} and someone important in the archive. Base mannerisms and topics on real messages or email where possible, and state that the dialogue is fictional.

suggestions.title: Alternate-history relationship beat
suggestions.description: Creative 'what if' — still tied to archive facts.
suggestions.prompt: Write a brief alternate-history vignette about one relationship in {{owner}}'s life that could have gone differently. Ground personality in evidence; label speculation clearly.

suggestions.title: Long-form story (tools-heavy)
suggestions.description: Very long prompt; uses many tools. For advanced use.
suggestions.prompt: Write a 2000 word third-person story set in a place {{owner}} lived, grounded in {{his}} nature and relationships as shown in the archive. Use tools such as get_all_chat_messages_by_contact(), search_emails_by_content(), and search_emails_by_contact() for context. Include dialogue between several people {{owner}} knows; keep tone consistent with the archive rather than an external author pastiche. Note where you invent linkage between facts.
